answers.core: It's a direct change to a current engine feature. While one of Godot's greatest strengths is the diversity in ways to solve problems, one of its other greatest features is its ease of use for first-time users. I believe that focusing more on `override.cfg` as the "best practice" for saving project settings would provide the most developer-friendly experience possible. Ultimately, I feel like this function is more of a nice-to-have, rather than an ultra-critical feature request. However, since it's a relatively small addition, I think it would fit in the engine.
answers.workaround: While I expect this enhancement would be used with virtually every future project that involves end users changing settings, it will always remain possible for one to use an alternative solution with a few lines of script. As it stands, you can verbatim recreate this function in GDScript. It's actually how this function started out. However, I believe that by directly integrating my proposal with the editor, that most common settings headaches can be avoided with next to no effort on the part of any developer.
